items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: So I never played with him too much, but I knew him and I played with him a few times, but he was conducting the band then.

ctx.x: Oh, he had a lot of bands. He had jobs all around Detroit. But his main ones were the Greystone band is where the one band played and then the other one was the Book Cadillac band, and Owen Bartlett had that, and then he had other little hotels and he free-lanced, he had a job here and a job there and well, you wouldn't remember, but at that time there was a lot of work around, lot of dances, lot of things being done, but -- so I figured I had made a contact and I got home and I wrote out an arrangement.
